brief:
Israeli opposition leader Yair Lapid warned that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's continued leadership would jeopardize Israel's security and worsen its international isolation following the US election results, Middle East Eye reported. Lapid's comments reflect anxiety among Israeli political figures about the implications of the election outcome for Israel's standing and strategic position.

Netanyahu's political opponents have grown increasingly vocal about concerns regarding the country's international relationships and security posture in light of the election and his leadership during this period.

title: Israeli opposition leader warns Netanyahu endangers security after US election
